saw_lines: Mothers buying a lactation supplement research it at night, then reorder the same bottle every month without comparing again.
So the sale is decided in the first line, where a mother checks whether the proof and offer are worth reading.
Your site shows 160+ countries and 84,000 five-star reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry either number. Open two ads with a review quote and print 84,000 five-star reviews on every creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 160+ countries and 84,000 five-star reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry either number. Mothers compare supplements on proof before they click. Open two ads with a review quote and print 84,000 five-star reviews on every creative.
Your site offers a first order discount, yet 0 of 18 ads mention it. A new buyer has no reason to act today. Put that discount in the first line of three new ads and say first order plainly.

Your site sells Subscribe and Save, yet 0 of 30 ads mention a subscription. Daily users are the buyers most likely to reorder, and they never hear the option exists. Run two retention ads with the subscription saving as the headline.
Your site lists prices from $14.99 to $45.99, yet 0 of 30 ads mention price. Buyers comparing supplements want the cost before they click. Lead one ad with the price per box and the cost per day.
